t: Mi sheakal debar issur im mitztarep lezimmun
s: Mi sheakal debar issur im mitztarep lezimmun, ubo z' seipim: mi sheakal debar issur, ap al pi sheeno asur ella middibre soperim — en mezammenin alayv. Veyesh omerim shehu haddin sheen mebarek acharayv birkat hammazon, apillu akal beshogeg, sheen abera mitzva. Veim yodea shehu asur uba leoklo — eno mebarek alayv battechilla, sheen zeh mebarek ella menaetz, kemo shekkatub "ubotzea berek — nietz Hashem". Veyesh omerim shello ameru ken ella bemitzva habbaa baabera, sheen rauy lehazkir aleha shem shamayim, veen mebarekin aleha birkat hammitzvot, sheen abera mitzva, abal birkat hannehenin tzarik lebarek, apillu haokel issure tora bemezid, ki mi sheokel shum verecho nodep — yachazor veyokal shum acher sheyyehe recho nodep beyoter, veyehaneh gam ken mehaolam hazzeh belo beraka? Velo maneu ella lezammen alayv, lepi sheen chaberayv rashshaim lehitchabber immo bachabura. Ubene chabura shekkullan akelu middebarim haasurim, gam hem en lahem qeba, sheen qeba vechibbur lidbarim haasurim, vahare zeh keen akilat perot sheen lahem qeba lezimmun. Abal beraka techilla vasop, lamma lo yebarek? Hoil venehena. Uleinyan halaka, yesh lehakria sheim akal issur beshogeg — yebarek achareha, abal hammezid lo yebarek lo battechilla velo bassop, sheen zeh mebarek ella menaetz:

Im gazal o ganab lechem apuy, ap al pi shekkebar nityaashu habbealim — eno mebarek alayv battechilla, lepi sheim hayu habbealim baim letobo mimmennu — haya chayyab lehachaziro lahem, velo haya yakol liptor et atzmo bedamim, nimtza sheakilato hi baabera, ubirkato niutz. Abal mebarek acharayv birkat hammazon, shekkeshekkebar akalo hu shello, vedamim hu chayyab lo. Veap sheakal beissur, kevan sheachar haakila yakol liptor et atzmo bedamim sheyyehe mah sheakal shello — en birkato az niutz:

Im gazal chittim o qemach veapa pat — mebarek gam battechilla, shekkebar qenao beshinnuy venaasa shello, sheim bau habbealim yakol liptor et atzmo bedamim, veen akilato abera. Veap al pi shekkayyotze bazeh bemitzva eno mebarek aleha, hoil umikkol maqom al yede abera baa leyado, kemo shennitbaer besiman y"a - en ledammot birkat hannehenin lebirkat hammitzvot, mittaam shennitbaer bassebara haacharona shebbisip a'. Veap lassebara harishona enan domot ella keshennehena baabera, velo keshebbau al yede abera. Veyesh choleqin bazeh (usepeq berakot lehaqel):

Vekol zeh begannab vegazlan atzmo, abal acherim mebarekin battechilla ubassop ledibre hakkol, shehare lo al yede abera baa leyadam, ella im ken ganab lechem apuy velo nityaashu habbealim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trm"t:
Im akal issur bimqom sakkana, ledibre hakkol mebarek alayv techilla vasop, shehetter hu okel, umitzva hu oseh lehatztzil napsho:

Shelosha sheakelu keachat veechad mehem akal pat nokri vehashshenayim nizharim mimmennu, o sheechad mehen kohen veakal challa, ap al pi shehi asura lehashshenayim — mezammenin alayv, hoil vehi mutteret lo. Veim hayu kohanim im zar okelin keechad vehazzar okel pat nokri vehakkohanim nizharim mimmenna veokelim challot — enan mitztorpin lezimmun, shekkol tzerup lezimmun eno ella keshehem yekolim lehitchabber yachad baakilatam leekol lechem echad, vekan kol echad nizhar millechem chabero. (Mah sheen ken keshehazzar eno okel pat shennizhar mimmenna hakkohen sheokel challa, ap shehazzar eno yakol leekol millachmo shel kohen, kevan shehakkohen yakol leekol millachmo shel yisrael, o hashshelishi sheokel pat nokri yakol leekol im hashshenayim — mitztorpim):

Veken echad okel gebina ushenayim basar — mitztorpim, shehaokel gebina yakol leekol millachmam ap al pi shehu meluklak bebasar, im yeqannach piv vidichennu. Abal im okel gebina qasha — enan mitztorpin, shehamminhag akshav shello leekol basar achar gebina qasha al yede qinnuach vahadacha. Veken bisudat mitzva merosh chodesh ab ad tisha beab, shemmiqtzat haqqeruim okelim gebina, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqn"a, kevan shennizharim mibbasar mechamat hamminhag — en mitztorpin im okele basar, utzerikim lezammen leatzman, ella im ken akelu kezayit pat qodem sheokele basar hitchilu leekol basar belachmam, shekkezayit zeh hayu yekolim leekol millachmo, o sheechad mibbene hasseuda akal kezayit lechem acher sheeno meluklak lo bebasar velo bechalab, shezzeh metzarep et kullam, shehare kullam yekolim leekol millachmo. Veken shelosha shemmuddarim hanaa zeh mizzeh, o apillu echad shemmuddar mishshenayim vehashshenayim mimmennu, ap al pi sheyyekolim lishol al nidram, kol zeman shello nishalu — en mitztorpin im kol echad okel mishshello. Abal im okelim mishshel baal habbayit — mitztorpin (shedderek baal habbayit lehaakil orechim lechem kol tzorkam, veim ken ap im yokal zeh mipperusa shechatak zeh letzorek atzmo — eno nehena ella mishshel baal habbayit, kevan shello yechsar lachmo shel zeh, mah sheen ken beokele basar ugebina sheen yekolim leekol zeh mehapperusa shechatak zeh, ap al pi sheyyekolim lachtok kol echad perusa leatzmo mikkikkar echad, biprat qodem negiatam bebasar ubechalab — en zeh moil lechabberam uletzorpam, ki mah li kikkarot nipradim umah li kikkar echad):
